messages:
nate: Postmortem follow-up: we're still seeing three recurring vendor patterns — cloud control-plane surge, model-registry throttles, auth refresh storms. Need concrete owners, success metrics, and a short remediation cadence. Can people claim?
yuan: I can take control-plane mitigations. Quick plan: add client-side token-bucket, circuit-breaker tuned to 99.9th percentile, and region-aware failover. Deliverables: runbook + small chaos test. ETA: 7 working days.
priya: Ill own auth-provider work. Short-term: add jittered refresh + tiny in-process token cache + secondary provider failover wiring. Blocking: need security window for KMS rotation and vendor escalation contact.
arthur: Ill own model-registry throttles. Proposal: warmup job for hot models, read-only fallback serving last-known-good blobs, and a prefetch path for common requests. Canary plan: 10% staging -> 10% prod for 24h, then expand.
ops-bot: Created INF-9999: "deps/resilience-mini-sprint". Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-9999. Default due date set to 2028-01-10.
nate: Suggested success criteria: P99 spike reduction >=40% for the class, incident rate <=1/month within 45 days, and synthetic pass rate >=95%. Owners: yuan (cloud), priya (auth), arthur (registry). Mike (ops) will own telemetry.
yuan: Adding fallback snippet to INF-9999:
```json
{"fallback_order":["local-cache","registry-readonly","service-degrade"],"retries":{"attempts":3,"backoff_ms":[100,300,900]}}
```
arthur: Canary and warmup cron: staging 10% then prod ramp, cron pre-warm 02:15 UTC, measure memory delta. If cost >9% tag for tradeoff review.
priya: Sent vendor SLA/contacts request to partner-support@example.com; asked for burst windows, escalation, and a test token endpoint. Security: pinged sec for KMS rotation slot.
nate: Actions: 1) Owners add one-line subtasks in INF-9999 with estimates by EOD Thu; 2) Add rollback steps + oncall rotation to runbooks; 3) Schedule monthly 15m drills per pattern. Keep long discussion in the epic. :thumbsup:
